source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: D5 UT1: engine = zrender's morphing functions cut out of the dist, on PathProxy data real elements built; charts = option at T0 (run out, or `mid` ms into its enter), next with notMerge at T1, recorded at T1 + samplesMs. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3); style = the effective fill / stroke / lineWidth / opacity; snap = the path's transform and shape keys, g.* its Symbol group's. Every number is the hex of its double.

charts.note: four bars become four slices: the ids are the category names on both sides
four slices become four bars
bars become scatter symbols (circles, symbol transform)
scatter symbols become bars: the symbol opacity 0.8 goes to the bar's 1
a line's empty circles become bars; the polyline goes with its view
bars become a line's symbols; the polyline has no animator and fades in
turned triangles (symbolRotate 30, size [24, 16]) become slices
a ring (radius 30% - 60%) becomes bars
bars with borderRadius 6 become slices
horizontal bars (a category y axis) become slices
bars with a border and an opacity: stroke, lineWidth and opacity are the old style's own keys
both series carry id "sales": the same transition key
series ids differ ("a", "b"): no batch, the pie enters as a new view
ids differ but universalTransition.seriesKey is "k" on both
the pie has no universalTransition: it enters
only the pie asks for it: the old series is still a source
universalTransition: {enabled: false} on the pie
the pie does not animate (animation: false): no transition
A, B morph; C and D have no old element by their names (E, F): they enter, C and D of the bars go
item ids x1..x4 on both sides, names that differ
bar B is null (no element): slice B fades in (initProps, enter timing)
the pie's update timing: 800 ms linear, delay idx * 50
universalTransition.delay (idx, count) => 120 + idx * 50 + (count - 1) * 1000: one to one is (0, 1)
divideShape split: no division one to one
divideShape clone: no division one to one
the same series, recoloured: the same elements, their style from the old one (animateElementStyles)
the pie arrives 300 ms into the bars' enter: the bars morph from where they are
a line's symbols become scatter symbols
the same scatter series, its symbol rect -> circle: SymbolDraw makes new symbols, which morph
the symbol changes, and the points and the size: the old rects morph from where they were
bars -> slices, and 200 ms into that morph bars again: the slices morph back from where they are
the same series gains a bar and is recoloured: the kept bars' style from the old one, the new bar enters
seriesKey ["k", "j"] and ["j", "k"]: sorted and joined, the same key
the delay on the root option's universalTransition, the series' own is true
